components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Dark, square action button used across Hub, Polymind, and Puck.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid #191919; border-radius: 0; background: #191919; color: #ffffff; font: 400 18px/1.5 "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #383a32; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2455cc; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Square, bordered secondary control with a light surface.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid #bfc1b8; border-radius: 0; background: #f3f3ef; color: #191919; font: 400 18px/1.5 "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #e3e5dc; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2455cc; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: White, square field with a neutral outline and visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #85877e; border-radius: 0; background: #ffffff; color: #191919; font: 400 18px/1.5 "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2455cc; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-input:disabled { background: #e5e7df; }

components.name: Lime State Marker
components.description: Flat state marker used on Hub and Polymind session surfaces.
components.css: .ds-state-lime { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 0; background: #e3fa49; color: #191919; font: 700 14px/1.4 "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Participant Card
components.description: White, square participant container separated by a fine neutral border.
components.css: .ds-card { min-width: 0; padding: 14px 16px; border: 0; border-top: 2px solid #191919; border-radius: 0; background: #ffffff; color: #191919; font: 400 14px/1.7 "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #555650; }

narrative.overview:
The interfaces use a strict, high-contrast graphic language: near-black ink, a warm neutral ground, bold type, strong rules, and square controls. The result is direct and assertive while keeping the participant’s current task easy to find. Helvetica Neue with Helvetica and Arial fallbacks is an intentional local stack.

Hub, Polymind, and Puck are separate applications with related visual foundations and some surface-specific choices. Their controls communicate real actions and states. Do not add slogans, performance rhetoric, or other non-functional interface copy.
keyCharacteristics: Functional, almost Swiss structure with a bold typographic hierarchy.
Flat surfaces, square corners, and clear borders.
State accents vary by application and surface; preserve those distinctions.

rules.name: Surface-specific state colour
rules.body: Use lime for Hub and Polymind session/projection emphasis. Olive marks Puck links and arena graphics, and legacy Polymind status/follow text; it is not a general primary or focus colour. Preserve the lime fill and olive outline on selected Puck arena targets.

rules.name: Flat controls
rules.body: Keep controls square and flat. Use borders, contrast, spacing, and state fills to show structure.

dos: Do use the local Helvetica stack and observed ink, paper, and white foundations.
Do keep controls square, flat, bordered, and easy to identify as actions.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and responsive single-column reflow.
donts: Don't add slogans, performance rhetoric, or non-functional text to the interface.
Don't replace the square control language with rounded pills, soft cards, or decorative shadows.
Don't use olive as a primary button or focus colour; it marks local links, arena graphics, and legacy status text.
